religion_note: Registered membership at the end of 2020: 185,146 members of the Church of Norway (SSB table 12026, KOSTRA, summed over the fylke's kommuner) and 16,832 members of faith and life-stance communities outside it, by religion (SSB table 08531), of a population of 242,168; the rest belong to neither. A count of membership, not of belief. SSB places the Church's members by their parish, and counts members of the communities outside it only where the state grant is paid for them.
